correctness.rationale: Binary outdegree-one synchronous firing is exactly translation by one vertex, so maximal avalanche faces are translated triples. Triangle edges follow cyclic steps a,b,c; the one-skeleton is a cyclic Cayley graph with g=gcd(a,b,c) components. For a singleton gap not equal n/2, the corresponding orbit of n undirected edges appears exactly once among n distinct translated triangles; disjoint elementary free-edge collapses remove all triangles. Equilateral support instead consists of disjoint filled triangles; {q,q,2q} instead gives g tetrahedral boundary spheres. The remaining connected graph cycle rank E-n+g yields the stated S1 wedge counts including antipodal orbit of size n/2. Independently enumerated all 1365 support triples for n=3..14, rebuilt triangle orbits, performed actual elementary collapses, and checked component and graph ranks in every case. The all-n integral proof is based on the orbit/collapse counting, not the finite check.
residual_risks: Finite checks are only corroboration; proof relies on stated unrestricted symbolic/collapsing argument.
